blocks.text: As one of the most enduring and most successful bands of the 2010's OPM band explosion, SUD looks back on 15 years of music with ‘This Is How We Play’ concert this Nov. 28 at Samsung Hall. The Filipino pop-alt rock and soul band will be performing a special anniversary set with an orchestra.
